error_codes.HUFFMAN_SYMBOL_OUT_OF_RANGE: symbol type or range is invalid
error_codes.HUFFMAN_TRUNCATED_CODEWORD: available input ends at an internal Huffman node
error_codes.HUFFMAN_TABLE_INVALID: provider table fails exact structural validation
error_codes.JOC_COEFFICIENT_SCRATCH_EXCEEDED: candidate coefficient bits exceed 4344 before final payload capacity
error_codes.JOC_PAYLOAD_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED: candidate padded body bytes exceed selected capacity
error_codes.JOC_MINIMUM_REPRESENTATION_EXCEEDS_CAPAC: all deterministic retry states were exhausted after retryable capacity errors

transaction_contract.writer: build and validate the complete candidate in local scratch; swap writer bytes/cursor and consumer state only on success
transaction_contract.decoder: walk with a local cursor and local target; commit both only after one complete leaf
transaction_contract.failure: error returns no output and preserves writer, cursor, and consumer state byte-for-byte
transaction_contract.retry: the two capacity errors are attempt-local and trigger F05Q.7 retry; only retry exhaustion becomes JOC_MINIMUM_REPRESENTATION_EXCEEDS_CAPACITY

scope.closed: F05Q mode/table selection, full reset boundaries, sparse initial values and local transaction errors
scope.not_closed: audio-to-coefficient fit, quantizer inputs, full profile retry integration, whole JOC payload and end-to-end playback
